title: How One Honest Phone Call a Week Rebuilds a Godly Man's Brotherhood
caption:
A godly man schedules his confession. One phone call a week is the whole mechanism.

A thread of twelve doesn't know your specific sin. One brother who calls back does.

Put it on the calendar. Say the real thing, not the update. Let him ask back.

James 5:16: "Confess your sins to one another, that you may be healed." The healing's in the exchange.
